concept: STILL THERE. Your agent's working memory, written to disk as plain markdown, so a context wipe can't erase the plan. Open on the plan as an object, establish the three real files and the re-read-before-every-move discipline, then hit a hard /clear white-out and restore the plan from disk as the money shot. Close by rhyming the open for a clean loop. Warm amber field, hard cuts, one bloom on the restore.
money_shot_note: Scene 6 (morph): the /clear wipes everything, then 'gone' morphs into 'still there' as the plan reconstitutes from disk. It is the ONE thing only this project does, placed at ~68% of the runtime, carried by the single reserved bloom transition and a reverse-swell foley button.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts by default (cut register). The one reserved effect is a bloom, fired only on the cut into the restore money shot. No swipe between scenes.
music_direction: Ambient, warm, patient. A held pad that drops out on the /clear and swells back on the restore, so the music carries the wipe.
